notes.title: My Lovely Daughter is finally released
notes.content:

My Lovely Daughter, a twisted father-daughter relationship simulator filled with alchemy, sacrifice, and murder, is available NOW!

notes.title: Our next game "My Lovely Daughter" have a release date
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26669058/154a1b4d9f5f2f2216a256353a7d98f126c1f610.png[/img]

Prepare your spellbook! And most importantly, prepare your heart as you will soon be part of the dark, twisted story of love and family.

Yes! The release date for My Lovely Daughter is out!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter/

My Lovely Daughter is coming to Steam for PC, Mac, and Linux on 8 March 2018!

notes.title: Check out our current project "My Lovely Daughter"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26669058/b8be48d9429e962cf0abbc7f4c49d238de560366.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

As some of you know, we are currently developing another game titled, My Lovely Daughter. It is an alchemist simulator game that explores the depth of a father’s grief and how he will go to resurrect his daughter. 

We have been working on finishing the game for more than a year. Currently, we are working on wrapping up the game and preparing it for release.

As for now you can check out the game steam page and make sure put it on your wishlist if you like it.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter/

Regards,


Amethyst
